performance.verdict: Ads never launched; 5 overdue milestones are the real blocker.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — none completed, now 32 days overdue.
LSA + Search Go-Live and Meta Retargeting Launch were due 2026-08-01 — both unstarted, ads have run $0 spend across all 28 days.
GBP actions fell to 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 29–31) vs 10 in the prior 3 (Aug 26–28), a confirmed 3-day zero signal.
GHL shows 108 contacts and 10 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but is producing no booked consults.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid spend can run until stack test and site are cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are confirmed overdue by 32+ days: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (due Jul 31), and LSA+Search + Meta launch (due Aug 1). Zero paid spend has run across all 28 days as a direct result. Nacer to confirm completion of each blocker item by 2026-09-05. Success check: stack test marked passed, LSA verification submitted, site live, and at least one paid channel showing spend > $0 by next review.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 108 contacts, 10 opps, 0 appointments — diagnose whether booking flow or routing is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 108 contacts and 10 opportunities created but zero appointments booked and zero won deals. This means leads are entering the pipeline but the consult booking step is failing — likely a calendar/routing misconfiguration or missing booking link in the nurture flow. Sohib to confirm with the GHL lead whether calendar booking and auto-routing are wired and tested. Success check: at least 1 test appointment books end-to-end by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 3-day zero (Aug 29–31) after 28-day average of 3 actions/day — re-check Sep 4 for recovery or further drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 29–31), down from a 28-day average of roughly 3 actions per day and a prior-3-day total of 10. This may be a weekend/holiday pattern or early signal of reduced local visibility. No paid action is warranted yet. Re-check on 2026-09-04; if actions remain at or near 0 through that date, escalate to the Web/SEO team for a GBP health audit.
